offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and get SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage; "Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens"；Prototype Development $50 / 0.050 per 1M tokens；Production Deployment $500 / 0.045 per 1M tokens
offerings.price_basis: 基础档 Prototype Development（10,000 tokens/次 × $0.050/1M tokens 换算）; Premium 档为 $0.45/千次（$0.045/1M tokens）
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens（Toy Experiment 10 Million Tokens, Non-commercial use only CC-BY-NC）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（top five results with URLs and contents, in clean, LLM-friendly text / JSON entries）
offerings.note: "Reader will search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents"; RPM: 100 (free key), 1000 (premium key); latency ~2.5s。换算基于固定 10,000 tokens/次起始值。
